digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text send path (Cloud ADF + DC Wiki)
propositions: DC codec is one-way lossy (decode(encode(x)) ≠ x), so echo suppression must use state-based baseline diff (current Jira value vs last-synced), not codec round-trip validation.

Cloud and DC send paths must be cutover to rich codecs (ADF and Wiki render) with a new flag-gated config surface (reconciler.rich_text_cutover, defaults OFF) and lazy-import of optional marklas extra; absent marklas, the plain-text ADF fallback applies.

Two distinct baseline compares: emit-path uses plain inbound-decoded remote vs normalized local, baseline-path compares local through normalize_outbound to match decoded baseline_wire, preventing false echo on Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates).
Concurrent both-sides edits on the same field keep rebar's local value (local-wins) and raise the outbound-field-conflict alert with remote recorded, unchanged from a713.

Consecutiveness is persisted inline (rich_sha = sha256(rendered_wire)[:16] and rich_reemit counter) not inferred; at rich_reemit == 2, one POST-push GET refreshes the baseline via merge_baseline, and no per-pass timestamp is stored.

WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound must equal decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) to restore codec law; DC send sites (_map_local_to_dc_fields and _issues.py:111) must route through to_wire before fit, else un-rendered Markdown ships; comment-diff dedup key stays unchanged.
